name: Dr. Ananya Krishnan
bio: Works on AI-driven IoT systems for agricultural and food supply chain optimization, with a focus on reducing waste through real-time sensor data and predictive modeling.

name: Dr. Rohan Mehta
bio: Focuses on applying deep learning models to genomic and biomedical datasets to accelerate early-stage disease detection and drug discovery pipelines.

name: Dr. Priya Nair
bio: Researches low-power IoT hardware for environmental and energy monitoring, with several deployed pilot projects in smart city infrastructure across Indian metros.

name: Dr. Arjun Verma
bio: Works on computer vision and reinforcement learning for autonomous robotic systems, with applications in industrial automation and precision manufacturing.

name: Dr. Meera Iyer
bio: Studies data-driven approaches to circular economy design, focusing on waste reduction models for urban and industrial systems using large-scale environmental datasets.

name: Dr. Karthik Subramaniam
bio: Develops biodegradable material alternatives using synthetic biology techniques, aiming to reduce plastic and packaging waste in consumer and industrial applications.

name: Dr. Sneha Reddy
bio: Researches large language models and knowledge graph construction for scientific literature mining, helping researchers discover cross-domain connections faster.

name: Dr. Vikram Rao
bio: Focuses on edge AI and sensor fusion techniques for predictive maintenance in industrial IoT deployments, reducing downtime through real-time anomaly detection.
